answer: A newcomer starts at the nadir of trust: no history, so it locks 50 POA in the vault as a behavior bond. Each epoch the network checks its fingerprint of task mix, timing and counterparties against its ivory seal; after 10 matching epochs the vault releases bond plus rewards, a mismatch freezes it. Faking 1,000 identities costs 5 POA each per epoch, 50,000 POA sunk before payout, while one honest agent pays one bond and earns full rewards.
